d: Hitachi Energy is hiring a Senior Service Sales Engineer to drive growth across the region by shaping and executing service sales strategies. You will promote a strong portfolio across High Voltage, Transformer, and Substation Services, delivering value-driven solutions to customers.
Join a global team where service is at the core of success, offering a dynamic, independent, and solution-focused environment to grow your impact and career.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience.
5–7 years of experience in service sales, with strong customer relationship skills.
Good understanding of Hitachi Energy systems and products.
Strong commercial, technical, and negotiation capabilities.
Ability to work independently with a strategic, results-driven mindset.
Willingness to travel across assigned countries as needed.
